trap-negation-contrast.evidence: Eight X-not-Y constructions counted ('the exponent does, the prefactor does not'; 'it is not an assumption of this corpus; it is a cited result'; 'What it is not is a theorem'; 'derived, not calibrated'; 'a prediction, not a fit'; 'and not merely fitted'; 'a property of one summation variable, not of 4_1'; 'arithmetic, not analytic'; 'in the exponent bookkeeping, not in the constant'). Density is high, but this proposition's subject IS the partition of a formula's factors into literature / measured / derived, so each contrast separates two provenance classes the block has to keep apart. Substantive-mathematical-contrast false-positive class throughout.

trap-rhetorical-pivot.evidence: 'The constant cannot be lifted from DGLZ — but it need not be' and 'It does not have to be: it is now derived directly from the colored Jones' have the setup-then-reframe SHAPE, but both halves are separately verifiable claims (DGLZ's three convention offsets; the saddle derivation of k^2 = 1/2), and the second does not silently carry the first. Not a pivot in the trap sense.

trap-em-dash.evidence: 18 em-dashes in 1532 words (11.7 per 1000). Several are true paired parentheticals ('The analytic input — the Euler-Maclaurin expansion of s_k and Laplace's method — is now formalised'; 'det(Hess) — which is what tau_DG is — is an algebraic number'), but a substantial share append afterthoughts where a full stop or comma belongs: 'a value independent of c and d, hence of the number of components' follows one; 'so in k := ... the Hessian cancels' follows another; the 25-framings sentence runs three dash-joined clauses in a row; and '(normalisation_step_trivial_of_k_agree) — which excludes every candidate with g(1) != g(2)' tacks a consequence onto a citation.
trap-em-dash.notes: Proposed (structural, not applied — the block is dense and several dashes are load-bearing): split the three longest dash-chained sentences (the tau^2 framing sentence, the a-dependence sentence, and the residual-risk closer) into full stops, which alone would bring the density to roughly 8 per 1000.

trap-triples.evidence: Four triads: the proposition title 'what is literature, what is measured, what is derived'; DGLZ's 'at least three distinct additive offsets' (enumerated and real); Laplace's method 'produces three quantities' (saddle condition, Stirling factor, Hessian — real); and 'No trace field, no cusp number, no choice of manifold enters.' The last is the only reflex one: it is a rhetorical tricolon of negations rather than an enumeration of three things.
trap-triples.notes: If tightened: 'Nothing about the manifold enters.' carries the same claim without the tricolon.

trap-closing-aphorism.evidence: The block-final sentence is 'The tension lives in the exponent bookkeeping, not in the constant, at the cusp numbers tested.' — a scope-qualified technical claim (the qualifier is what disqualifies it as a composed closer). NOTE the pattern one level down: four paragraphs end on quotable lines ('The 4_1 calibration was never carrying information.'; 'The 4_1 calibration on which the whole c_sigma arc rested is thereby retired.'; 'The obstruction to extending the method is arithmetic, not analytic.'; 'neither of which was put in.'). Each states a real result, so none is a fail on its own; the regularity is worth noting.

trap-meta-commentary.evidence: 'Then the two factors have different provenance, and conflating them is the error this block exists to prevent.' narrates the document's own purpose rather than stating the mathematics — the textbook shape of the category. (Two further self-references were judged and PASSED as bookkeeping rather than emphasis-narration: 'and it is the one to state when citing this proposition', which tells a citing author which gap to name, and 'The distinction the proposition draws also fixes the shape of the residual risk', which introduces a derivation.)

The five bullets that follow already do the separating, so nothing is lost. Delimiter balance re-checked after the edit: 6 occurrences of the display delimiter, even.

trap-thesis-restatement.evidence: The two closing paragraphs state what remains open and analyse the residual risk — new content, not a restatement of the provenance split.

trap-superlative.evidence: 'The a-dependence is the sharpest part of this' is the only superlative and it is defended in the following clause (a enters only through a phase, so the whole dependence is interference). 'a far stronger test than the corpus previously had' is comparative and immediately qualified by 'and is still not a proof' — the opposite of inflation.

trap-nonspeakable.evidence: Two sentences exceed 60 words with three or more dash- or comma-joined clauses (the 'framing by mu - a*lambda ... 25 framings' sentence; the residual-risk closer). They parse, but stall aloud.
trap-nonspeakable.notes: Same fix as the em-dash entry: splitting those two sentences resolves both categories.
